payload.text: One clean unversioned contract with a single underlying discriminator: when decoding an instrument, `instrument_underlying_from_json` treats the rich cross-asset `underlying` oneof as authoritative whenever it is present and non-null (it carries the asset-class discriminator), and consults the legacy FX `pair` key only when no `underlying` is present — projecting it to `Underlying::fx`. There is exactly one precedence order (underlying ≻ pair), not a versioned negotiation. Pure: it reads the JSON map and returns a `Result`, mutating no state.
